name: Mentions
description: A multi-line text field that opens a floating suggestions list right at the caret when someone types @ or #, for tagging teammates, channels or issues inside comments and notes.

classes.ayy-mentions: Root wrapper around the textarea, caret anchor and suggestions listbox.
classes.ayy-mentions__anchor: Hidden zero-width anchor placed at the trigger character to position the popup.
classes.ayy-mentions__body: Name and handle row inside an option.
classes.ayy-mentions__label: Person or record display name, truncated on overflow.
classes.ayy-mentions__handle: Muted monospace @handle or #key at the inline end.

default.looks: Like Textarea: wash fill, 1px line-strong border, resizable vertically; suggestions hidden.

hover.when: :hover on the textarea or a suggestion option (hover devices)
hover.looks: Textarea border turns line-hover; hovered option gets Combobox's wash-hover.

pressed.none: No pressed look; choosing an option inserts the mention at the caret.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring outline (-1px offset); focus stays in the textarea while arrows move through suggestions.

disabled.when: :disabled on the textarea, or aria-disabled="true" on an option

selected.looks: --ayy-color-wash-hover fill on the active suggestion. Forced colours: Highlight fill.

error.when: aria-invalid="true" on the textarea (with a FieldError)
error.looks: Textarea's 60% destructive border and destructive focus ring.

loading.none: No loading look; disable while submitting and show a Spinner on the send Button.

open.looks: Floating surface-raised list anchored directly under the @ or # character, flipping above near the bottom edge.

sizes.density: Textarea and option rows follow control md text and data-density.
sizes.width: Textarea fills its container; popup is 13rem to 20rem wide.

js: mentionsClass({ className? }) → string; mentionsTextareaClass({ autosize?, mono?, className? }) → string; part class constants; connectMentions(root, { triggers?, onMention? }) → { close, refresh, destroy }.

element.description: Wires inline mention autocomplete onto an .ayy-mentions wrapper containing a <textarea> and .ayy-mentions__listbox.
element.children: An .ayy-mentions holding a <textarea class="ayy-textarea ayy-mentions__textarea"> and an .ayy-mentions__listbox of [role="option"] items.

events.ayy-mention: { trigger: string, value: string, label: string, text: string } — fired when a suggestion is inserted.

Mentions.renders: <div class="ayy-mentions"> wrapping <textarea>, caret anchor and <ul role="listbox">

props.options: MentionOption[] — id, label, value?, trigger?, icon?, keywords?, disabled?
props....rest: All native <textarea> attributes (value, defaultValue, rows, placeholder…).

a11y: Label the textarea with Field + Label (htmlFor/id), just like Textarea.
Focus stays inside the textarea: ArrowUp and ArrowDown update aria-activedescendant, Enter or Tab inserts, and Escape closes the popup without closing a parent Dialog.
Triggers only fire at the start of a line or after whitespace/punctuation, so typing email addresses never opens the popup.
do: Use Mentions for comments, review notes, chat composers and issue descriptions where people reference teammates (@) or records (#).
Pass keywords on options (such as role or full handle) so people find teammates either by name or username.
dont: Don't use Mentions to pick a list of assignees without prose — use Record picker.
Don't use Mentions for single-value autocomplete — use Combobox.
